_how: Put each list of your own in functions/eval/fixtures/photos-real/<name>/ (gitignored): its photos as page-1.jpg, page-2.jpg… in reading order, and a truth.json shaped like this file (without these _ keys). Then run: npx tsx functions/eval/photoEval.mts --only 'real-*'. One entry per line of the list, in order. 'expect' is the status a correct read gives the line (Queried, Partial Requested, Partial Sent, Full Requested, Full Sent, Revise & Resubmit, Offer, Rejected, Withdrawn, No Response); 'accept' lists any others that are equally right. 'date' is written exactly as on the page, or "" for none. 'mark' is a symbol after the line (✓ ✗ ? !). 'band' is optional: the line's top and bottom as fractions of the page's height; without it, src isn't scored.
